html:
SMTO-UI-0055 — This status check isn't available on this server

GUID: cbef4e15-8474-52e9-9692-064b608bbeb6
Slug: ui-recovery-check-unknown
Domain: UI · Subsystem: browser

What happened

  • The page asked the server for a status check the server doesn't have. This usually means the page and the server are different versions. Nothing was checked or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the System Health page. Reloading loads the list of checks this server actually offers.
  2. Run a check from one of the cards shown, such as Check Knowledge or a card's Refresh button. Those buttons only ask for checks this server supports.
  3. If this keeps happening, ask your administrator to check for an SMTO server update in Settings › Setup › Server updates. A page newer than the server can ask for checks the server doesn't have yet.

What success looks like

  • The check finishes and the card shows a current result.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, noting which page or button you used.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • POST /api/agent/system-health/checks returned 422 ui_recovery_check_unknown because the request named a check outside the server's supported set (server, knowledge, storage, models, gateways, accounts).

What this means

  • The submitted diagnostic name is not one of the checks this server supports. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported ui_recovery_check_unknown. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • A registered check returns a result.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • SystemHealth.check rejects any name not in CHECKS before probing anything. Reload System Health so it uses the server's current check list; if a client keeps sending an unknown name, its page assets and the Server version don't match, so update the Server through Settings › Setup › Server updates and reload.
  • Reload System Health and choose one of its available checks.

Retry and execution caution

  • A registered check returns a result.

How to verify the fix

  • A registered check returns a result.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
